Methodology & evidence

Rules, sources & what’s missing

Every recommendation can be traced to a source. Every major gap stays visible.

—
Academic threshold · 2026–27

Minimum eligibility is not a cutoff

  • The minimum average is based on marks obtained across all semesters of the qualifying examination.
  • The 2026–27 brochure says eligibility rounding and normalized marks are not considered for the minimum eligibility threshold.
  • Other requirements still apply, including qualification/equivalence, nativity, documentation and any claimed reservation.
  • Meeting the threshold does not promise a seat. Historical MAX / MIN cutoff marks describe a separate selection outcome.

Read official TNLEA 2026–27 instructions ↗

Model card

How the next-cycle estimate works

When the exact college + branch + category has both 2024 and 2025 MIN values, the planner extends the one-year difference forward to 2027. This is an intentionally simple linear baseline, not a trained or validated machine-learning model.

Why confidence is very low: the 2026 final cutoffs are not included in this snapshot; the forecast is two cycles beyond the latest reliable point, and seats, demand, rules and applicants can change. The app shows the observed years and values with every estimate.

Forecasts are planning context only and must never be treated as cutoff guarantees or individual ranks.

Known data gaps

Where the dataset still needs more source collection.

Historical / admissions

  • The current extraction is a sample, not the full state-wide TNLEA list.
  • 2022 cutoff records were not recovered.
  • 2023 is a partial indexed extract; its attempted original PDF URL returned an invalid document.
  • 2024 and 2025 official cutoff PDFs are represented by sampled extracted records, not every row in those PDFs.
  • The complete 2026 final cutoff and individual rank lists are not included.

Institution profile / costs

  • Seat matrix, intake, vacancies by round, approvals, accreditation validity and placements are not comprehensively linked.
  • Tuition and hostel fees are only shown where the amount and year are traceable.
  • Some college addresses come from historical cutoff listings; they may not be suitable for navigation without checking the map and official website.
  • A missing branch/category row does not prove a course or seat does not exist.
